# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven or eight years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired young boy with yellow ringlets, a snub nose, and a dimpled cheek. He is recognized by his bright ringlets and small pink tongue.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004)_

## Personality

Robin is energetic, mischievous, curious, and inquisitive, frequently bringing trouble through careless and forgetful antics. He possesses a merry disposition and a natural gift for winning affection despite his rebellious streak. Driven by high spirits and occasional devilment, he routinely asks practical and imaginative questions while remaining deeply loving and remorseful when his misdeeds hurt others.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 c22 P8](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0008), [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c8 P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056)_

## Traits

- Energetic and high-spirited  <sub>[v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004)</sub>
- Mischievous and prone to misbehavior  <sub>[v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)</sub>
- Inquisitive and curious  <sub>[v2 c22 P8](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0008)</sub>
- Affectionate  <sub>[v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041)</sub>

## Abilities

- Politeness under persuasive reasoning  <sub>[v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure an Indian headdress using white rooster tail feathers  <sub>[v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016)</sub>
- To enjoy equal affection and attention from Nell  <sub>[v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c19 P38](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0038)</sub>

## History

Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by Thirza Abernethy to reside at Grey Shutters. After settling into the household, his energetic antics and poor table manners routinely drew stern reprimands from Thirza, such as when he licked his plate after asking for extra maple syrup or when he snuck a live toad into Thirza's bed under her pillow. He attended Brierley School under Nell Harcourt's instruction, where his misbehavior gradually decreased. He felt competitive toward Cedric Stanhope for Nell's affection, briefly refusing to recite his bedtime prayers out of jealousy before being persuaded by Nell. Upon learning that his late uncle Richard Farrow bequeathed a trust fund for his and Lucy's care, Robin expressed immense joy that Grey Shutters had officially become his permanent home.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

## Background by volume

- Twin brother of Lucy Farrow  <sub>[v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007)</sub>
- Nephew of the late Richard Farrow  <sub>[v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
- Orphaned following the death of his mother  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
- Brought to live at Grey Shutters under the care of Thirza Abernethy  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
